parameters.query:
SELECT 
  ep.user_id,
  jsonb_agg(
    jsonb_build_object(
      'product_id', ep.product_id,
      'product_name', lp.product_name,
      'interest_rate', lp.interest_rate
    ) ORDER BY lp.interest_rate ASC NULLS LAST, ep.product_id ASC
  ) AS products
FROM eligible_pairs ep
JOIN loan_products lp ON ep.product_id = lp.product_id
GROUP BY ep.user_id;

UPDATE match_runs
SET 
  status = 'completed',
  finished_at = now(),
  users_processed = (SELECT count(DISTINCT user_id) FROM matches WHERE match_run_id = '{{ $('Start match_run').first().json.match_run_id }}'),
  pairs_before_filter = {{ $('Funnel Metrics').first().json.pairs_before_filter }},
  pairs_after_sql = {{ $('Funnel Metrics').first().json.pairs_after_sql }},
  pairs_after_rules = (SELECT count(*) FROM matches WHERE match_run_id = '{{ $('Start match_run').first().json.match_run_id }}'),
  llm_calls_made = 0
WHERE match_run_id = '{{ $('Start match_run').first().json.match_run_id }}';
